mainEntity.name: Do I need a camera crew or an actor?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. A product link, one product photo, or a written brief is enough. The workspace writes the script, casts an AI presenter, adds the voice and captions, and exports the finished file.
Three inputs: a public product page (URL to Video), a product photo (Image to Video), or a creative brief (Text to Video). Everything else is chosen in the workspace.

mainEntity.name: How much does a video cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A 15-second video costs 20 credits and a 30-second video costs 40. Package credits are 200 for $24, 500 for $59, or 1,200 for $129 per month of the term. The cost is shown before every job, and a failed job returns its credits.

mainEntity.name: Does the file carry a watermark?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Downloads are watermark-free and can be used in paid ads, on your store, or in client work, subject to each platform's current rules.
Yes. New users can start with a free trial and a one-time $1 first product video. Creators who post with #AIVideosUGC can also apply for free credits.
